arcades.info_text: Fair Play Diversões is an arcade inside the Maxi Shopping mall, located on the 2nd floor, close to the Food Court of the mall. / It has various arcade types: mostly Racing Games and Crane Machines at the store-front; Hoops and Elevators in the middle of the store; older arcades and Bumper Cars at the back. / They work with a Barcode Card, meaning the card just has a barcode to be scanned in the arcade-machine's scanner. / You can refill your card with either R$25, R$50, or R$75. You get R$25 in BONUS when refueling any of the three values. / Normal Credits are used first, and then Bonus Credits. / You get tickets by playing any arcade, and they can be traded for prizes at the counter in the entrance of the arcade. / Almost, if not all of the machines cost the same: R$10,00 normal price, R$9,80 VIP price. These prices don't change on weekends or holidays. / Almost none of the machines have a card-saving system (like Aime or Banapassport). The ones that have use a PIN-Code system.

arcades.info_text: Shopping Center Arcade in São Paulo. / HotZone is a Brazilian arcade chain that mixes classic arcade games—with newer attractions such as VR rides and 4D cinema experiences. / This particular location is on the ground floor of MorumbiShopping, close to Exit C. It actually takes up several store units, and you can enter directly through Entrance C. Despite the large space, it’s usually very crowded, which says a lot about how popular it is. The arcade is air-conditioned, so at least you won’t melt while playing. / HotZone doesn’t sell food or drinks inside, but you’re allowed to bring your own, which is a big plus. The arcade runs on a card-based balance system: you load credits onto a card using cash or credit/debit cards (Visa and Mastercard are accepted). Any balance you add is valid for 180 days from the last time you use it. / If you recharge R$100 or more at once, you get VIP status. This gives you a 25% discount from Monday to Friday, and 15% off on weekends and holidays—pretty solid if you go often. / There are two types of credits: Normal and Bonus. Machines that only accept Normal credits have a pink-glowing card reader, while machines that accept both Normal and Bonus...
